environment_admin_api_key_guidance: Local dev may use local-only .env files that remain ignored by git.
Staging must use environment-managed ADMIN_API_KEY or secret manager injection.
Production must use managed secrets only; no raw secret values in repo, docs, command history, screenshots, or reports.
ADMIN_API_KEY must not appear in URLs, query strings, route bridge metadata, logs, report output, or public bundle code.
Rotate ADMIN_API_KEY before paid launch if it has ever appeared in local logs, shared terminals, screenshots, or issue text.
Cross-app base URLs should use VITE_SHRV1_BASE_URL and VITE_SHF_NEXT_BASE_URL or deployment-specific equivalents.
Cross-App Route Bridge must keep secrets out of route URLs and preserve public/internal classification.
Staging and production CORS/proxy/API Gateway policy should be documented before any external exposure.

public_safe_release_guardrails: Truth Spine remains the only authority for verification, report readiness, trust package state, and public approval preconditions.
Public Approval and Data Approval Gateway remain the only correct path toward public release decisions.
No layer may directly mutate shfImpactData or bypass SHF Impact Data Spine controls.
No layer may mark records public_approved outside the approved gateway/human review path.

SHS private operational data remains blocked from SHF public surfaces unless governed, de-identified or aggregated where needed, verified, privacy-reviewed, ownership-reviewed, readiness-approved, public-approved, and gateway-approved.
Security/Privacy and Data Ownership/IP checks are required before public release.
Reports and Watchtower may expose readiness and risk metadata, but they must not convert draft/unverified data into public facts.
AI, Oracle, Game Theory, LOO, automation, webhook, notification, and warehouse layers must not publish or approve public data.
